newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sanford declares 1/10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Sanford declares 1/10 bonus issue.

text.p: Fishing company Sanford Ltd said on Thursday it had declared a taxable one-for-10 bonus issue at NZ$3.00 per share.
The issue is payable in two instalments in January 1996 and June 1996 and new shares do not qualify for the final dividend but will qualify for the first half dividend of 1997.
The registration date is November 11 and full imputation credits will apply.
The company said trading conditions for the ensuing 12 months will be difficult and the company does not have the extent of foreign exchange forward cover in place as the previous two years.

In spite of the difficulties which all export industries are facing, the company said it is confident that it has the catching, processing and quota base to maximise opportunities of the next 12 months.
